value.message: Oakville's Learn to Swim Preschool A runs Saturdays 9:00-9:30 and Preschool B 9:40-10:10, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for ages 3 to 5 with no parent in the water - their site says. Registration opens Aug 11 at 7am for residents; I could not pin down the price, and I'll keep watching and text you when I can.
